record.bible_text: And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto Moses<WH04872> in mount<WH02022> Sinai<WH05514>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Speak<WH01696><WTH8761> unto the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, and say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto them, When ye come<WH0935><WTH8799> into the land<WH0776> which I give<WH05414><WTH8802> you, then shall the land<WH0776> keep<WH07673><WTH8804> a sabbath<WH07676> unto the LORD<WH03068>. <RF>keep: Heb. rest<Rf>

Six<WH08337> years<WH08141> thou shalt sow<WH02232><WTH8799> thy field<WH07704>, and six<WH08337> years<WH08141> thou shalt prune<WH02168><WTH8799> thy vineyard<WH03754>, and gather<WH0622><WTH8804> in the fruit<WH08393> thereof;

But in the seventh<WH07637> year<WH08141> shall be a sabbath<WH07676> of rest<WH07677> unto the land<WH0776>, a sabbath<WH07676> for the LORD<WH03068>: thou shalt neither sow<WH02232><WTH8799> thy field<WH07704>, nor prune<WH02168><WTH8799> thy vineyard<WH03754>.

That which groweth of its own accord<WH05599> of thy harvest<WH07105> thou shalt not reap<WH07114><WTH8799>, neither gather<WH01219><WTH8799> the grapes<WH06025> of thy vine undressed<WH05139>: <FI>for<Fi>  it is a year<WH08141> of rest<WH07677> unto the land<WH0776>. <RF>of thy vine...: Heb. of thy separation<Rf>

And the sabbath<WH07676> of the land<WH0776> shall be meat<WH0402> for you; for thee, and for thy servant<WH05650>, and for thy maid<WH0519>, and for thy hired servant<WH07916>, and for thy stranger<WH08453> that sojourneth<WH01481><WTH8802> with thee,
And for thy cattle<WH0929>, and for the beast<WH02416> that <FI>are<Fi> in thy land<WH0776>, shall all the increase<WH08393> thereof be meat<WH0398><WTH8800>.<CM>

And thou shalt number<WH05608><WTH8804> seven<WH07651> sabbaths<WH07676> of years<WH08141> unto thee, seven<WH07651> times<WH06471> seven<WH07651> years<WH08141>; and the space<WH03117> of the seven<WH07651> sabbaths<WH07676> of years<WH08141> shall be unto thee forty<WH0705> and nine<WH08672> years<WH08141>.

Then shalt thou cause the trumpet<WH07782> of the jubile<WH08643> to sound<WH05674><WTH8689> on the tenth<WH06218> <FI>day<Fi> of the seventh<WH07637> month<WH02320>, in the day<WH03117> of atonement<WH03725> shall ye make the trumpet<WH07782> sound<WH05674><WTH8686> throughout all your land<WH0776>. <RF>of the jubile: Heb. loud of sound<Rf>

And ye shall hallow<WH06942><WTH8765> the fiftieth<WH02572><WH08141> year<WH08141>, and proclaim<WH07121><WTH8804> liberty<WH01865> throughout <FI>all<Fi> the land<WH0776> unto all the inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802> thereof: it shall be a jubile<WH03104> unto you; and ye shall return<WH07725><WTH8804> every man<WH0376> unto his possession<WH0272>, and ye shall return<WH07725><WTH8799> every man<WH0376> unto his family<WH04940>.

A jubile<WH03104> shall that fiftieth<WH02572><WH08141> year<WH08141> be unto you: ye shall not sow<WH02232><WTH8799>, neither reap<WH07114><WTH8799> that which groweth<WH05599> of itself in it, nor gather<WH01219><WTH8799> <FI>the grapes<Fi> in it of thy vine undressed<WH05139>.
For it <FI>is<Fi> the jubile<WH03104>; it shall be holy<WH06944> unto you: ye shall eat<WH0398><WTH8799> the increase<WH08393> thereof out of the field<WH07704>.
In the year<WH08141> of this jubile<WH03104> ye shall return<WH07725><WTH8799> every man<WH0376> unto his possession<WH0272>.

And if thou sell<WH04376><WTH8799> ought<WH04465> unto thy neighbour<WH05997>, or buyest<WH07069><WTH8800> <FI>ought<Fi> of thy neighbour's<WH05997> hand<WH03027>, ye shall not oppress<WH03238><WTH8686> one<WH0376> another<WH0251>:

According to the number<WH04557> of years<WH08141> after<WH0310> the jubile<WH03104> thou shalt buy<WH07069><WTH8799> of thy neighbour<WH05997>, <FI>and<Fi> according unto the number<WH04557> of years<WH08141> of the fruits<WH08393> he shall sell<WH04376><WTH8799> unto thee:

According<WH06310> to the multitude<WH07230> of years<WH08141> thou shalt increase<WH07235><WTH8686> the price<WH04736> thereof, and according<WH06310> to the fewness<WH04591><WTH8800> of years<WH08141> thou shalt diminish<WH04591><WTH8686> the price<WH04736> of it: for <FI>according<Fi> to the number<WH04557> <FI>of the years<Fi> of the fruits<WH08393> doth he sell<WH04376><WTH8802> unto thee.
Ye shall not therefore oppress<WH03238><WTH8686> one<WH0376> another<WH05997>; but thou shalt fear<WH03372><WTH8804> thy God<WH0430>: for I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>.

Wherefore ye shall do<WH06213><WTH8804> my statutes<WH02708>, and keep<WH08104><WTH8799> my judgments<WH04941>, and do<WH06213><WTH8804> them; and ye shall dwell<WH03427><WTH8804> in the land<WH0776> in safety<WH0983>.
And the land<WH0776> shall yield<WH05414><WTH8804> her fruit<WH06529>, and ye shall eat<WH0398><WTH8804> your fill<WH07648>, and dwell<WH03427><WTH8804> therein in safety<WH0983>.

And if ye shall say<WH0559><WTH8799>, What shall we eat<WH0398><WTH8799> the seventh<WH07637> year<WH08141>? behold, we shall not sow<WH02232><WTH8799>, nor gather<WH0622><WTH8799> in our increase<WH08393>:
Then I will command<WH06680><WTH8765> my blessing<WH01293> upon you in the sixth<WH08345> year<WH08141>, and it shall bring forth<WH06213><WTH8804> fruit<WH08393> for three<WH07969> years<WH08141>.

And ye shall sow<WH02232><WTH8804> the eighth<WH08066> year<WH08141>, and eat<WH0398><WTH8804> <FI>yet<Fi> of old<WH03465> fruit<WH08393> until the ninth<WH08671> year<WH08141>; until her fruits<WH08393> come in<WH0935><WTH8800> ye shall eat<WH0398><WTH8799> <FI>of<Fi> the old<WH03465> <FI>store<Fi> .<CM>

The land<WH0776> shall not be sold<WH04376><WTH8735> for ever<WH06783>: for the land<WH0776> <FI>is<Fi> mine; for ye <FI>are<Fi> strangers<WH01616> and sojourners<WH08453> with me. <RF>for ever: or, to be quite cut off: Heb. for cutting off<Rf>
And in all the land<WH0776> of your possession<WH0272> ye shall grant<WH05414><WTH8799> a redemption<WH01353> for the land<WH0776>.

If thy brother<WH0251> be waxen poor<WH04134><WTH8799>, and hath sold<WH04376><WTH8804> away <FI>some<Fi> of his possession<WH0272>, and if any of his kin<WH07138> come<WH0935><WTH8804> to redeem<WH01350><WTH8802> it, then shall he redeem<WH01350><WTH8804> that which his brother<WH0251> sold<WH04465>.

And if the man<WH0376> have none to redeem<WH01350><WTH8802> it, and himself<WH03027> be able<WH01767><WH05381><WTH8689> to redeem<WH04672><WTH8804><WH01353> it; <RF>himself...: Heb. his hand hath attained and found sufficiency<Rf>

Then let him count<WH02803><WTH8765> the years<WH08141> of the sale<WH04465> thereof, and restore<WH07725><WTH8689> the overplus<WH05736><WTH8802> unto the man<WH0376> to whom he sold<WH04376><WTH8804> it; that he may return<WH07725><WTH8804> unto his possession<WH0272>.

But if he<WH03027> be not able<WH01767> to restore<WH04672><WTH8804><WH07725><WTH8687> <FI>it<Fi> to him, then that which is sold<WH04465> shall remain in the hand<WH03027> of him that hath bought<WH07069><WTH8802> it until the year<WH08141> of jubile<WH03104>: and in the jubile<WH03104> it shall go out<WH03318><WTH8804>, and he shall return<WH07725><WTH8804> unto his possession<WH0272>.

And if a man<WH0376> sell<WH04376><WTH8799> a dwelling<WH04186> house<WH01004> in a walled<WH02346> city<WH05892>, then he may redeem<WH01353> it within a whole<WH08552><WTH8800> year<WH08141> after it is sold<WH04465>; <FI>within<Fi> a full year<WH03117> may he redeem<WH01353> it.

And if it be not redeemed<WH01350><WTH8735> within the space<WH04390><WTH8800> of a full<WH08549> year<WH08141>, then the house<WH01004> that <FI>is<Fi> in the walled<WH02346> city<WH05892> shall be established<WH06965><WTH8804> for ever<WH06783> to him that bought<WH07069><WTH8802> it throughout his generations<WH01755>: it shall not go out<WH03318><WTH8799> in the jubile<WH03104>.

But the houses<WH01004> of the villages<WH02691> which have no wall<WH02346> round about<WH05439> them shall be counted<WH02803><WTH8735> as the fields<WH07704> of the country<WH0776>: they may be redeemed<WH01353>, and they shall go out<WH03318><WTH8799> in the jubile<WH03104>. <RF>they may...: Heb. redemption belongeth unto it<Rf>

Notwithstanding the cities<WH05892> of the Levites<WH03881>, <FI>and<Fi> the houses<WH01004> of the cities<WH05892> of their possession<WH0272>, may the Levites<WH03881> redeem<WH01353> at any time<WH05769>.

And if a man purchase<WH01350><WTH8799> of the Levites<WH03881>, then the house<WH01004> that was sold<WH04465>, and the city<WH05892> of his possession<WH0272>, shall go out<WH03318><WTH8804> in <FI>the year of<Fi> jubile<WH03104>: for the houses<WH01004> of the cities<WH05892> of the Levites<WH03881> <FI>are<Fi> their possession<WH0272> among<WH08432> the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>. <RF>a man...: or, one of the Levites redeem them<Rf>
But the field<WH07704> of the suburbs<WH04054> of their cities<WH05892> may not be sold<WH04376><WTH8735>; for it <FI>is<Fi> their perpetual<WH05769> possession<WH0272>.

And if thy brother<WH0251> be waxen poor<WH04134><WTH8799>, and fallen in decay<WH04131><WTH8804> with thee<WH03027>; then thou shalt relieve<WH02388><WTH8689> him: <FI>yea, though he be<Fi> a stranger<WH01616>, or a sojourner<WH08453>; that he may live<WH02416> with thee. <RF>fallen...: Heb. his hand faileth<Rf> <RF>relieve: Heb. strengthen<Rf>
Take<WH03947><WTH8799> thou no usury<WH05392> of him, or increase<WH08636>: but fear<WH03372><WTH8804> thy God<WH0430>; that thy brother<WH0251> may live<WH02416> with thee.
Thou shalt not give<WH05414><WTH8799> him thy money<WH03701> upon usury<WH05392>, nor lend<WH05414><WTH8799> him thy victuals<WH0400> for increase<WH04768>.

I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>, which brought you forth<WH03318><WTH8689> out of the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>, to give<WH05414><WTH8800> you the land<WH0776> of Canaan<WH03667>, <FI>and<Fi> to be your God<WH0430>.<CM>

And if thy brother<WH0251> <FI>that dwelleth<Fi> by thee be waxen poor<WH04134><WTH8799>, and be sold<WH04376><WTH8738> unto thee; thou shalt not compel<WH05647><WTH8799> him to serve<WH05656> as a bondservant<WH05650>: <RF>compel...: Heb. serve thyself with him with the service, etc<Rf>
<FI> But<Fi> as an hired servant<WH07916>, <FI>and<Fi> as a sojourner<WH08453>, he shall be with thee, <FI>and<Fi> shall serve<WH05647><WTH8799> thee unto the year<WH08141> of jubile<WH03104>:

For they <FI>are<Fi> my servants<WH05650>, which I brought forth<WH03318><WTH8689> out of the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>: they shall not be sold<WH04376><WTH8735> as<WH04466> bondmen<WH05650>. <RF>as...: Heb. with the sale of a bondman<Rf>
Thou shalt not rule<WH07287><WTH8799> over him with rigour<WH06531>; but shalt fear<WH03372><WTH8804> thy God<WH0430>.

Both thy bondmen<WH05650>, and thy bondmaids<WH0519>, which thou shalt have, <FI>shall be<Fi> of the heathen<WH01471> that are round about<WH05439> you; of them shall ye buy<WH07069><WTH8799> bondmen<WH05650> and bondmaids<WH0519>.

Moreover of the children<WH01121> of the strangers<WH08453> that do sojourn<WH01481><WTH8802> among you, of them shall ye buy<WH07069><WTH8799>, and of their families<WH04940> that <FI>are<Fi> with you, which they begat<WH03205><WTH8689> in your land<WH0776>: and they shall be your possession<WH0272>.

And ye shall take them as an inheritance<WH05157><WTH8694> for your children<WH01121> after<WH0310> you, to inherit<WH03423><WTH8800> <FI>them for<Fi> a possession<WH0272>; they shall be your bondmen<WH05647><WTH8799> for ever<WH05769>: but over your brethren<WH0251> the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, ye shall not rule<WH07287><WTH8799> one<WH0376> over another<WH0251> with rigour<WH06531>. <RF>they...: Heb. ye shall serve yourselves with them<Rf>

And if a sojourner<WH01616> or stranger<WH08453> wax rich<WH05381><WTH8686> by thee<WH03027>, and thy brother<WH0251> <FI>that dwelleth<Fi> by him wax poor<WH04134><WTH8802>, and sell<WH04376><WTH8738> himself unto the stranger<WH01616> <FI>or<Fi>  sojourner<WH08453> by thee, or to the stock<WH06133> of the stranger's<WH01616> family<WH04940>: <RF>wax rich...: Heb. his hand obtain, etc<Rf>
After<WH0310> that he is sold<WH04376><WTH8738> he may be redeemed again<WH01353>; one<WH0259> of his brethren<WH0251> may redeem<WH01350><WTH8799> him:

<FI> And<Fi> as a yearly<WH08141><WH08141> hired servant<WH07916> shall he be with him: <FI>and the other<Fi> shall not rule<WH07287><WTH8799> with rigour<WH06531> over him in thy sight<WH05869>.

And if he be not redeemed<WH01350><WTH8735> in these <FI>years<Fi> , then he shall go out<WH03318><WTH8804> in the year<WH08141> of jubile<WH03104>, <FI>both<Fi> he, and his children<WH01121> with him. <RF>in these...: or, by these means<Rf>

For unto me the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> <FI>are<Fi> servants<WH05650>; they <FI>are<Fi> my servants<WH05650> whom I brought forth<WH03318><WTH8689> out of the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>.<CM>
